member.name: T:CS2TraceRay.Class.CTraceFilterVTableManaged
member.summary:
Allocates a managed vtable that the engine calls back into when iterating entities for a trace. Our ShouldHitEntity function honors EntityIdsToIgnore from the filter (works around the engine's built-in vtable not respecting our skip list).
Layout taken from SwiftlyS2: Windows = [Destructor, ShouldHitEntity].

member.name: T:CS2TraceRay.Struct.CTraceFilter
member.summary:
Updated CTraceFilter layout matching SwiftlyS2 (which works on current CS2 builds). The original CS2TraceRay layout was outdated — fields had drifted positions, and the engine read garbage where InteractsWith/HitSolid were expected. With this layout the trace correctly hits world brushes.
Total size: 72 bytes [0x00] Vtable (filled in by TraceHull from gamedata sig) [0x08] QueryShapeAttributes (56 bytes — see RnQueryShapeAttr_t below) [0x40] IterateEntities (Windows; Linux uses 0x3A)

member.name: T:CS2TraceRay.Struct.RnQueryShapeAttr_t
